metadata.description: The Atlanta BeltLine trails, split by named segment and build status.
metadata.source: OpenStreetMap, via an Overpass export in data/sources/osm-beltline-trails.geojson. Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
metadata.note: Gaps between segments are real: the loop is not continuous yet. Segments are not bridged across anything wider than a street crossing.
